Subject: AWS Marketplace metering + fulfillment: info & timeline request

Hi Vivek / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency and routing controls. Procurement/legal asked me for a concrete runbook for Marketplace metering and fulfillment so we can align on contract language and billing start. Can you provide: 

- Exact entitlement keys we will receive (license format we send to customers vs what AWS provides)
- Metering signal and event shape (what you expect from our product to call MeterUsage or SendUsage records)
- Webhook endpoints for fulfillment + retry semantics
- Proposed mutual action plan and go-live date windows (we prefer early Oct)

I attached a first-pass SOW for Redline. Legal will want to see DocuSign-ready contract and the invoice start date tied to Marketplace fulfillment.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
DataSlate Analytics
procurement@dataslate.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering + fulfillment: info & timeline request

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. Outlined below is a compact runbook and mutual action plan (MAP). I attached a mapping workbook that maps DataSlate SKUs to Redwood entitlements.

Runbook summary
- Entitlements: Redwood will surface a license token per customer in the Seller Entitlement Service. Primary keys: product_code (string), entitlement_type ("monthly_users" | "api_calls"), unit ("user" | "call"). AWS will mirror entitlement via the entitlement API call during fulfillment.
- Metering: We support both "metered usage" and a seat proxy. For DataSlate we recommend a hybrid: Monthly active users (MAU) as a seat entitlement (fixed monthly charge) + API calls as metered (MeterUsage).
- Webhooks & delivery: Redwood will provide two endpoints:
  1) /marketplace/fulfillment (POST) — receives fulfillment notifications from your backend (signed HMAC).
  2) /marketplace/metering/callback (POST) — used for async metering receipts / reconciliation.
  Retry semantics: 3 attempts at 1, 5, 30 minutes; 24-hour dead-letter and manual reconciliation.

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Week 0 (this week): Finalize SOW redlines and sign via DocuSign (link below).
- Week 1: Exchange test credentials; Redwood provides sandbox entitlement API and metering stub.
- Week 2: Integration smoke tests (user provisioning, MeterUsage end-to-end).
- Week 3: Canary (1% of traffic) + billing preview.
- Go-live target: 2027-10-03 (billing effective at first fulfilled usage after go-live).

Attachments: redwood-metering-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet mapping SKUs & entitlements)
Related links: HubSpot deal DS-2027-0412, DocuSign template: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abc123

Let me know if Legal wants different invoice triggers. Ben, adding you for webhook payload + retry confirmation.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering + fulfillment: info & timeline request

Hi Asha — Ben here, engineering on the fulfillment side. Quick answers and a sample payload below.

Proration: Redwood's billing engine supports day-level proration for metered and seat entitlements. For metered API calls we report MeterUsage entries with a timestamp and quantity; AWS will bill on their cycle. For contract language we recommend: 
- "Metered usage is billed based on MeterUsage events reported by the Seller; prorations are calculated on day-level increments and reflected in the first invoice after the billing cycle."

Co-sell: Yes — we can link a marketplace SKU to the listing and accept co-sell referrals. We'll coordinate the marketplace publishing step with your Partner Manager.

Webhook HMAC: We sign payloads with HMAC-SHA256. Validate header X-Redwood-Signature and use the shared webhook secret.

Sample MeterUsage (example):
{
  "product_code": "RLWD-DS-0001",
  "customer_identifier": "cust-12345",
  "timestamp": "2027-10-03T00:00:00Z",
  "usage_dimension": "api_calls",
  "usage_quantity": 452
}

Can we kick off the sandbox creds exchange Monday? We'll also publish a short integration checklist in Confluence and share the link.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Engineer, Fulfillment & Metering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-metering-mapping.xlsx (contains sample payloads & SKU mappings)
